From King Nothing · Price: you need an item the target touched.

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: You can track a creature by scent; +2 Survival to Track. 1 action: your stand follows the scent of a creature within 30 ft and pounces where it's about to be: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[bludgeoning]] (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}); on a failure it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} until the start of your next turn (1 minute on a critical failure), as you smell each move before it makes it.
  • 5: You know its location within 1 mile. Surge: in a fight, read the trail it's about to make, and your stand is waiting where it steps: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[bludgeoning]] (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}); on a failure it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} for 1 minute, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 1} too on a critical failure.
  • 9: Surge: follow a scent back to learn where the target was 1 hour ago.
  • 13: You can track through teleportation.
  • 17: You know its location within 10 miles.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
